White students made up 34.4% of James Foote School enrollment in 2024-25
K. B. Beebe
Data from the Michigan Department of Education show 106 white students were enrolled at James Foote School in the 2024-25 school year, a 5.4% decline from the previous year.
The school enrolled 308 students in the 2024-25 school year. White students made up 34.4% of the student body, the second-largest group. Hispanic students were the largest group, making up 42.9% (132) of the student body.
The school is located in School District of the City of Lincoln Park School District with a central office in Lincoln Park.
Of the 11 schools in School District of the City of Lincoln Park School District, Lincoln Park High School had the highest enrollment of white students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. It set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget preserved free school meals and included full funding for pre-K and community college.
